text:
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT 1769456789 — High inference latency affecting hosted API in us-west-2. Severity: SEV2. Trigger: p99 latency > 8s (last 10m).
Maya Patel: seeing errors spike in the routing layer, requests piling up on node pool A.
Rob Chen: digging into GKE autoscaler and pod restarts now. logs: ```k8s: pod kube-inference-7f4 restart x3 within 5m, OOMKilled on worker 2```
Samir Ahmad: observed KV cache thrash on the LRU eviction. likely due to hot-prefix churn after a large reroute.
Jess Ortega: @Maya any customer-facing impact numbers? Emily (CS) - do we have a list of sessions timing out?
Emily (CS): account-ids impacted: 12 (most notable: fintech-corp, docs-gen). ~1.2k requests failed in 12m window. customers on dedicated pools unaffected.
Maya Patel: mitigation plan: 1) scale up pool B, 2) shift new traffic away from pool A via routing rules, 3) enable degraded model fallback (quantized variant) for non-dedicated tenants. doing 1 now.
Rob Chen: scaled pool B + 4 GPUs. patching routing rule: `route override pool: poolB region: us-west-2`
Deploybot: Rollout started: routing-policy v3 -> targeting poolB for 30% new traffic (canary).
Samir Ahmad: enabling fallback model for text-generation endpoints for free-tier/paid-tier mixed traffic: `model: redwood-mini-q4` as fallback. Doing config update.
Maya Patel: after 6m - p99 dropped to 1.1s, error rate down to 0.6%. continuing monitoring.
Emily (CS): drafted a short customer note for the accounts team. tagging @Jess for approval before sending.
Jess Ortega: quick review: please include: brief impact, mitigation, what we’re doing next, and an ETA for RCA. Keep it simple.
Maya Patel: agree. Also logging action items for post-incident: root cause analysis, fix for cache eviction, autoscaler tuning, and routing rule test-suite updates.
Rob Chen: collecting kube logs and core dumps; uploading to shared bucket: https://s3.company.internal/incidents/1769456789/logs (internal)
Samir Ahmad: estimate for a permanent mitigation: 2 weeks to implement KV cache metrics + LRU prioritization patch, 3 days to deploy autoscaler policy change with stress tests.
Emily (CS): customer comms plan: (1) immediate status page update with incident summary, (2) targeted emails to impacted accounts with CS handoff, (3) follow-up with detailed RCA when ready.
Maya Patel: can someone own the postmortem and schedule? I can run the technical postmortem session, but need an author.
Jess Ortega: I can own the customer-facing RCA doc + coordinate with accounts. scheduling: propose postmortem review Wed 2025-05-07 16:00 UTC (2h).
Maya Patel: works for me. Rob + Samir please prepare short pre-reads (logs, timeline, mitigation steps) by Tue EOD.
Rob Chen: will upload a timeline artifact and a grep-friendly log bundle by Tue 17:00 UTC.
Samir Ahmad: I'll put a draft of the cache eviction repro and the mitigation PR link in the pre-read.
Emily (CS): CS will prepare personalized notes for the five largest affected customers; I'll send to Jess for sign-off by Wed 09:00 UTC.
Maya Patel: Action items (quick list):
- A1: Root cause analysis doc (owner: Maya Patel) — due: postmortem meeting
- A2: Cache eviction fix PR (owner: Samir Ahmad) — due: 2025-05-14
- A3: Autoscaler policy + stress test (owner: Rob Chen) — due: 2025-05-10
- A4: Routing test-suite & canary automation (owner: Eng Platform) — TBD (assign in retro)
- A5: Customer follow-up emails + account notes (owner: Jess Ortega / Emily (CS)) — initial outreach: 2025-05-07 morning
Jess Ortega: I'll send the initial customer note after I get CTL approval. Draft (for review):
"Hi — We experienced elevated inference latencies in us-west-2 earlier today that affected a subset of hosted API requests. We mitigated by shifting traffic to alternate capacity and enabling a fallback model; error rates are now back to baseline. We're investigating root cause and will share a detailed RCA in one week. If you have any immediate concerns, please reach out to your account contact."
Maya Patel: suggested tweak to include: "No dedicated or private deployment customer data was exposed or affected."
Jess Ortega: added that line.
Oncall Bot: Handoff reminder: current on-call is Maya Patel until 2025-05-06 08:00 UTC. Paging escalation: Rob Chen (secondary).
Maya Patel: handing off to night oncall @Rob — please keep watch on p99 and error-rate alerts. I'll be on standby for the postmortem tomorrow.
Rob Chen: ack, will keep an eye. Setting alert threshold lower for the night: p99 > 1.5s alert.
Emily (CS): status page update posted: https://status.company.internal/incident/1769456789 — includes customer-facing summary and mitigation steps.
Maya Patel: recording interim notes for the postmortem doc now. Please add any missed details to the thread. Great job team, rapid mitigation here — need to focus on stopping the recurrence and improving runbooks. :thumbsup:
Jess Ortega: will collect CS outreach confirmations and post here after sending.
Emily (CS): first two customers acknowledged and accepted the interim note; no immediate requests for SLA credits yet.
Maya Patel: closing the incident channel for active work. If further regressions happen reopen with `!incident reopen 1769456789`. Postmortem invites sent.
Rob Chen: archived the canary rollout logs and noted the rollback window in the postmortem pre-read.
Samir Ahmad: adding a test-case to the nightly regression suite to simulate hot-prefix churn.
Jess Ortega: thanks all — will post the customer RCA link in this thread once published.
